title: You're Not That Guy, Pal
blurb: It is not shouted, and that is exactly what makes it lethal. A raised voice can be dismissed as anger; this is delivered calmly, almost kindly, as a piece of information being shared for the recipient's own benefit — which leaves absolutely nowhere to go. It became the internet's favourite deflation of tough-guy energy for that reason. Play it when somebody's confidence writes a cheque their abilities cannot cover: gym clips, ranked lobbies, LinkedIn posts about resilience. An instant humility delivery system, with next-day dispatch.
origin: From a viral street-interview clip; the definitive tough-guy deflation line.
